I think about this year the same way I thought about last year — start from what worked, and only change a little. I am 60 now, been farming these 7 mu for 40 years. My wife helps, two of my sons work in town, so at busy time I sometimes pay 100 yuan a day for extra hands.

My land is split. About 4 mu is the main wheat-maize plot — the soil there is decent loam, good for the double crop. Then 1.5 mu I keep for cotton, because I've grown cotton since I was young and I know how to handle it. The last 1.5 mu I put in watermelon — it sells well at the roadside in summer, better cash than anything else if the melons are sweet.

For **wheat**: last year I used about 40 kg of 15-15-15 compound at sowing, then 20 kg of urea when it greened up in spring. That gave me around 500 kg/mu, I think I will do the same. Fertilizer prices are still high this year so I will not add more. I irrigate 3 times from the well — before winter, at jointing, and at grain filling. Spray twice for aphids and rust. I rotary-till after the maize stalks are chopped.

For **summer maize**: I direct-seed right into the wheat stubble — no tillage, saves time and diesel. I use 50 kg compound as starter and topdress 25 kg urea at the big bell stage. Neighbor Lao Wang got 580 kg last year this way, I did about 550. Two irrigations usually enough since July-August has rain. Spray once for borer.

For **cotton**: cotton is harder now, bollworm even with the Bt seed. I plough deep in spring, put down 40 kg compound plus some farmyard manure, topdress 15 kg urea at budding and 10 kg at flowering. Spray 5 times through the season. Irrigate twice from well. Expect about 250 kg seed cotton.

For **watermelon**: this one I spend more on because the return is good. Plough, lay plastic film, use 2 carts of chicken manure plus 50 kg compound and 15 kg potassium sulfate — the extra potash makes them sweeter, the buyer pays more. Irrigate 4-5 times through fruit setting. Spray 3-4 times for anthracnose and aphids. If weather is kind I get 3500 kg/mu.
